text: Setups, fret work, electronics and hardware for the guitars you already own — done with the same care as a full build.
Wooden pickup covers, rings, truss rod covers and knobs, shaped by hand from natural wood.
A Main Line commission — Mathetēs or Petros — shaped around how you play and what you want it to say.
The Redemption Series: one-of-one instruments from wood with a story already in it.
